title: apps/dashvalidator: control flow map (dashboard compatibility check)
answers: How does a dashboard compatibility check request flow through apps/dashvalidator?
Where is the dashvalidator check route handled?
Where do I add a new datasource type for dashvalidator validation?
body:
apps/dashvalidator is an App-SDK app (not pkg/services) exposing one custom route `POST .../check`: given dashboard JSON + a datasource mapping, it scores whether the dashboard's queries reference metrics that exist on the target datasource. Gated by `featuremgmt.FlagDashboardValidatorApp`.

Flow (file:symbol hops):
- Frontend: `public/app/features/dashboard/dashgrid/DashboardLibrary/api/compatibilityApi.ts:checkDashboardCompatibility` → `/apis/dashvalidator.grafana.app/v1alpha1/.../check`.
- Wiring: `pkg/registry/apps/dashvalidator/register.go:RegisterAppInstaller` builds the shared `cache.MetricsCache`, registers Prometheus's `cache.MetricsProvider`, builds `validators map[string]validator.DatasourceValidator`, wraps in `DashValidatorAppInstaller` (coarse authz in `GetAuthorizer`). Registered in `pkg/registry/apps/apps.go`/`wireset.go` per the generic App-SDK wiring rule.
- Route registration & handling: `apps/dashvalidator/pkg/app/app.go:New` wires `VersionedCustomRoutes["v1alpha1"]["POST check"]` → `handleCheckRoute`, which enforces single-datasource MVP rule, validates UID, does per-datasource `ac.Evaluate` permission checks, resolves the datasource (`datasourceSvc.GetDataSourceInNamespace`) and an authenticated HTTP client (`datasourceSvc.GetHTTPTransport`), then calls `validator.ValidateDashboardCompatibility`.
- Datasource-agnostic core: `apps/dashvalidator/pkg/validator/dashboard.go:ValidateDashboardCompatibility` extracts queries, groups by datasource UID, dispatches to the registered `DatasourceValidator`.
- Prometheus implementation: `prometheus/validator.go:(*Validator).ValidateQueries` → `parser.go:(*Parser).ExtractMetrics` (PromQL AST walk) after `interpolation.go:interpolateForParsing` rewrites template vars → `cache.go:(*MetricsCache).GetMetricsSet` (TTL+singleflight) → on miss `provider.go:(*PrometheusProvider).GetMetrics` → `fetcher.go:(*Fetcher).FetchMetrics` (Prometheus `/api/v1/label/__name__/values`).
- Response: `app.go` `handleCheckRoute` → `convertToCheckResponse` builds the wire struct, JSON-encoded.

Note `GetKinds()` in `app.go` returns an empty map: the `DashboardCompatibilityScore` CUE kind (`kinds/dashboardcompatibilityscore.cue`) is currently unused/dead — the live route's request/response shape is NOT generated from it.

Tests: table-driven + testify throughout; `pkg/app/validation_test.go` uses `httptest` for the handler layer; dedicated `*_test.go` per component (parser, interpolation, cache, fetcher) plus `benchmark_test.go` files in both `validator/` and `validator/prometheus/`.
